description: This Java source file contains an abstract class implementation for JSON Web Tokens (JWT), providing parsing, validation, and access methods for JWT components such as header, payload, and signature.

classes.name: AbstractJsonWebToken
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the JsonWebToken interface, providing core functionality for handling JWTs including parsing, field extraction, and validation.

methods.name: AbstractJsonWebToken(JsonWebToken)
methods.description: Constructor copying data from an existing Jwt instance.

methods.name: AbstractJsonWebToken(String)
methods.description: Constructor parsing and decoding a JWT string into header, payload, and signature components.

methods.name: tryToDecodeJwtPart(String)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 URL-encoded JWT part and converts it into a JSON object, handling errors.

methods.name: decodeJwtPart(String)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 URL-encoded string and parses it into a JsonObject.

methods.name: getHeader()
methods.description: Returns the JWT header as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getBody()
methods.description: Returns the JWT payload as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getToken()
methods.description: Returns the raw JWT string token.

methods.name: getKeyId()
methods.description: Returns the Key ID (kid) from the header.

methods.name: getIssuer()
methods.description: Returns the issuer (iss) from the payload.

methods.name: getSignature()
methods.description: Returns the signature part of the JWT.

methods.name: getAudience()
methods.description: Returns the audience (aud) as an Audience object.

methods.name: getAuthorizedParty()
methods.description: Returns the authorized party (azp) claim from the payload.

methods.name: getScopes()
methods.description: Returns the list of scopes included in the JWT.

methods.name: getExpirationTime()
methods.description: Returns the expiration time (exp) as an Instant.

methods.name: isExpired()
methods.description: Checks whether the JWT is expired based on current time.

methods.name: equals(Object)
methods.description: Checks equality based on token, header, body, and signature.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on token components.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the JWT including token components.
